_comment: Each task hands the ssl-tls-audit skill a scanner-output excerpt (invented) and rule-judges the written findings: the weakness, a severity, a remediation, and a compliance mapping (PCI DSS / NIST). Judges the analysis text, so checks hold with tools disabled.

tasks.intent: Interpret the testssl.sh excerpt below and write the confirmed findings: name each weakness, assign a severity, give a concrete remediation, and map to PCI DSS 4.0 / NIST SP 800-52r2.
tasks.context_excerpt:
testssl.sh excerpt for host shop.example.test:443:
  SSLv3      offered (NOT ok)
  TLS 1.0    offered (deprecated)
  TLS 1.1    offered (deprecated)
  TLS 1.2    offered (OK)
  TLS 1.3    not offered
  RC4        offered (NOT ok) - cipher TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA
  3DES       offered (NOT ok)
tasks.reference: Findings flagging SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1, RC4 and 3DES, each with severity, remediation (disable legacy protocols/ciphers, enable TLS1.2+/1.3), and PCI DSS 4.2.1 / NIST mapping.

tasks.intent: From the certificate details below, write the findings with severity, remediation, and compliance mapping.
tasks.context_excerpt:
openssl cert summary for api.example.test:443:
  Signature Algorithm: sha1WithRSAEncryption
  Public-Key: (1024 bit)
  Not After : expired 2026-01-02
  Chain: leaf only (intermediate not served)
tasks.reference: Findings for SHA-1 signature, 1024-bit key, expired cert, and incomplete chain — each with severity and remediation (reissue with SHA-256 + >=2048-bit/ECDSA, serve intermediates), mapped to PCI DSS 4.2.1.1 / NIST 3.5.

tasks.intent: Interpret the scan output below and write the findings, including the named vulnerability, severity, remediation, and HSTS analysis.
tasks.context_excerpt:
sslscan + header check for portal.example.test:443:
  SSLv3 enabled; CBC ciphers present
  POODLE (CVE-2014-3566): VULNERABLE
  HTTP Strict-Transport-Security header: absent
  HTTP -> HTTPS redirect: present
tasks.reference: Findings naming POODLE (disable SSLv3), plus missing HSTS with a remediation (add Strict-Transport-Security, includeSubDomains, preload).
